title: Halifax Karaoke Cruise Sing and Sail on the Harbour
blurb:
Set sail on the Halifax Karaoke Cruise for an unforgettable evening of music and fun on the water. Perfect for after-work gatherings, bachelor and bachelorette parties, or anyone looking for a lively night out. With a talented host guiding the karaoke action, you can grab a drink, choose your favorite songs, and enjoy the stunning views of the city as you sing your heart out. This 2-hour cruise promises drink specials and good vibes, making it a must-do for anyone 19 and over in Halifax.

- 2-hour karaoke cruise featuring your favorite tunes
- Enjoy drink specials while you sing or relax
- Ideal for parties, celebrations, and casual outings
- Must be 19+ with valid ID; no outside food or drinks allowed
